[[Kaykitt's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Kaykitt Hidemender]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Verdant Cascades]].

==Stats== 
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:Halves casting time of [[Healing Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Healing Prayers]] spells (Chance: 20%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Healing Ankh]].

==Replica==
An exact replica, including visual appearance, for this item is a [[Healing Ankh]] from collectors [[Mourn Drakespur]], [[Radamon]], or [[Keotah]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].


It is possible to create an exact replica, including visual appearance, for this item with:
*[[Healing Ankh]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Healing Prayers]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
The [[Healing Prayers]] version of [[Droknar's Focus]] has stats identical to this item.
